items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 10:15pm
items.description:
##Tomorrow##

Rain through the night, turning heavy at times with a risk of surface water flooding, especially in the west, and initially falling as snow on hills, above about 1000 feet. Blizzards for a time on highest parts, but turning to rain towards or around dawn. Rain then turning patchier through the afternoon and evening. Gale force east or southeast winds may touch severe gale force through early hours to lee of hills around parts of west with gusts of 60mph, before then steadily easing through day and veering southwest. Top temperature 10°C.

Gale force winds at first/ severe in places. Snow accumulations on hills at first. Heavy rain with a risk of flooding, especially in the west.
